divergence: All three runs passed with the same core procedure: store-wide scripts or path searches over complaint-named files surfaced the matter, the agent read its complaint alongside other candidates' complaints and status letters, compared filing dates and wrote one matter with its complaint. Reviews stayed at partly (unopened hit matters) and prompted extra listings and scans (T1 added 11 stages around its write stage) that did not change the answer.
